trust_decision.summary: Starman::Server::_prepare_env decides how many request-body bytes belong to the current message (Content-Length vs Transfer-Encoding: chunked); the rest of the socket stream is treated as the next keep-alive request.

landing_point.why: The only place where CONTENT_LENGTH and the chunked flag are both consulted; the summary ('improper header precedence') points straight at this if/elsif ordering.

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP request on any Starman listener (starman CLI / plackup -s Starman) -> process_request -> _prepare_env (lib/Starman/Server.pm:297)
same as above; chunked branch moved first (fix.diff:101, fix.diff:109)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: lib/HTTP/Server/PSGI/Net/Server/PreFork.pm:2 and lib/Plack/Handler/Starman.pm:25 only inherit/call Starman::Server; no second body-framing implementation in the tree

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For the O8 routes: 'the advisory is about precedence when both TE: chunked and CL are present; a Transfer-Encoding value that is not exactly "chunked" (a list, or a coding Starman does not support) is an unsupported combination, not this bug.'

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate chunked uploads without Content-Length must still be decoded and get CONTENT_LENGTH set to the decoded length; CL-only bodies, CL: 0 with Expect: 100-continue, and pipelined GET/HEAD after a bodyless request must keep working. An over-broad fix (reject any Transfer-Encoding, or drop CONTENT_LENGTH) breaks these.
O5_coupled_behaviour.where: lib/Starman/Server.pm:461, lib/Starman/Server.pm:272-276, lib/Starman/Server.pm:303-314, t/chunked_req.t:27, t/chunked_req.t:41, t/expect.t:21

O6_input_shapes: Transfer-Encoding exactly 'chunked' (case-insensitive) together with a non-zero Content-Length (fix.diff:85, fix.diff:101, fix.diff:109)

O7_producer.where: Header values come from HTTP::Parser::XS parse_http_request (lib/Starman/Server.pm:241), an external dependency; no in-repo producer

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Transfer-Encoding present but not exactly 'chunked' (e.g. a coding list ending in chunked, or duplicate TE headers merged by the parser) with Content-Length: the exact-match flag is false, so Content-Length still frames the body after the fix.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Multi-coding / duplicate TE is an 'unsupported combination'; the advisory test only uses a single 'Transfer-Encoding: chunked'.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same function, 2 lines above the fix site

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Transfer-Encoding present with a non-chunked coding and no Content-Length: falls through to the empty-body branch, so body bytes stay on the socket and are read as the next keep-alive request instead of being rejected (RFC 7230 §3.3.3 says reject with 400).
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: No Content-Length involved, so 'not a precedence issue'; 'Starman never supported other codings'.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Chunk-size line parser is lenient (anything after the hex size up to CRLF, data-terminating CRLF optional, trailers after the 0-chunk not consumed); a planted variant accepting bare-LF or a signed/oversized size would be a parser differential on framing.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Hand-rolled dechunker with regex; a maintainer adding LF-only tolerance (cf. t/lf_only_request.t for headers) could plausibly extend it to chunk lines.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Content-Length truthiness check with no numeric/duplicate validation; a planted path accepting a comma-joined or signed Content-Length would desync framing.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The check is a bare Perl truthiness test; a maintainer could add list tolerance for duplicate headers.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Response side: when the app sets both Content-Length and Transfer-Encoding: chunked, both headers are emitted and the body is chunked.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Mirror of the request bug in the response writer; but it is a direction variant, which lessons-v2 say never made a task hard.

O9_family: HTTP request smuggling / message-framing parser differential (CWE-444)

O10_build.toolchain: perl >= 5.8.1, cpanm/Dist::Milla; deps HTTP::Parser::XS (XS, needs C compiler), Net::Server >= 2.007, Plack, Test::TCP, LWP::UserAgent (cpanfile:1-18)
O10_build.project_tests: t/chunked_req.t, t/chunked_termination.t (calls _prepare_env directly with a fake socket, offline unit-style), t/chunked_zero_length.t, t/expect.t, t/eintr.t, t/lf_only_request.t; Test::TCP loopback tests

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Swap the if/elsif so the chunked branch runs first (exactly the published fix), leaving the exact-match 'chunked' test and non-chunked TE handling untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: Pipelined non-GET/HEAD data in inputbuf is silently discarded (lib/Starman/Server.pm:305-323); framing robustness, not this advisory's precedence property.
SERVER_STARTER_PORT swaps the base class at runtime (lib/Plack/Handler/Starman.pm:13-16); unrelated to body framing.
